title: No bucket policy allows access to anyone
message: Bucket demo-public-assets policy allows access to anyone (Principal '*')

# or remove it entirely: aws s3api delete-bucket-policy --bucket <BUCKET>

title: No AMIs or EBS snapshots are shared publicly

aws ec2 enable-image-block-public-access --image-block-public-access-state block-new-sharing
aws ec2 enable-snapshot-block-public-access --state block-all-sharing
